title: Portfolio Build — 4 End-to-End Production Systems in 12 Weeks
summary: The objective is not to accumulate project count. The objective is to build four systems that prove complete ownership of the AI/ML lifecycle and create enough depth to defend architecture, tradeoffs, failures, benchmarks, cost, security, and scaling decisions in an interview.

projects.proves: Production GenAI / applied AI engineering: multi-tenant agents, RAG, MCP, APIs, event-driven workflows, security, evals, observability
projects.sentence: Build a production-style multi-tenant AI due-diligence/research platform where a user can ask about a property, company, or document set and watch a planner execute retrieval, SQL, calculations, and external tools before generating an evidence-backed memo.
stack: Phoenix or equivalent LLM tracing/eval tooling

crash_course.title: Portfolio Build — 4 End-to-End Production Systems in 12 Weeks
crash_course.summary: The objective is not to accumulate project count. The objective is to build four systems that prove complete ownership of the AI/ML lifecycle and create enough depth to defend architecture, tradeoffs, failures, benchmarks, cost, security, and scaling decisions in an interview.

days.title: agent-platform: Service foundation and local environment
days.build: Create/rebuild agent-platform repo structure. FastAPI service with /health/live and /health/ready. Docker Compose: API, Postgres+pgvector, Redis. Pydantic settings with environment validation. Structured JSON logging and request IDs. Unit test for liveness; integration test for readiness. Makefile/task runner for up, down, test, lint, migrate.
days.drill: docker compose up --build && curl localhost:8000/health/live && curl localhost:8000/health/ready && pytest -q
days.done: readiness verifies Postgres and Redis independently; killing either dependency changes readiness without killing the API process; tests are green.

days.title: agent-platform: Relational model, migrations, tenancy
days.build: Alembic or explicit SQL migrations. Tables: tenants, users, documents, chunks, runs, run_steps, approvals, audit_events. pgvector extension. tenant IDs on every tenant-owned row. unique/idempotency constraints. indexes justified by expected query patterns. seed acme and globex tenants. first RLS policies and isolation tests.
days.done: a test deliberately attempts cross-tenant reads/writes and fails at the database layer, not only in application code.

days.title: agent-platform: Real ingestion and idempotency
days.build: ingest TCAD/City of Austin structured data or equivalent real corpus. PDF ingestion with page/paragraph metadata. deterministic document and chunk IDs. 800-token baseline chunker. embeddings with bge-small-en-v1.5 or justified alternative. batch embedding and retry behavior. rerunning ingestion must add zero duplicates.
days.done: real structured data + >=500 document chunks are queryable and a complete rerun produces zero duplicate logical records.

days.title: agent-platform: Retrieval baselines
days.build: retrieval/bm25.py. retrieval/vector.py. small hand-labeled evals/retrieval.jsonl (>=30 queries initially). metrics: Recall@5/10, MRR, NDCG, P50/P95 latency.
days.done: BENCHMARKS.md contains the first actual retrieval table, not claims.

days.title: agent-platform: Hybrid retrieval and reranking
days.build: hybrid BM25+dense via RRF. cross-encoder reranker. metadata filtering. retrieval API endpoint.
days.drill: Experiment: Record quality and P95 latency for all four.
days.done: you can state which mode wins on your corpus, by how much, and at what latency cost.

days.title: agent-platform: Tool layer and direct LLM runtime
days.build: direct Anthropic/OpenAI SDK runtime; no orchestration framework yet. tools: search_docs, sql_query, calc, fetch_url. read-only SQL role, SELECT-only enforcement, statement timeout. Pydantic schemas for tool input/output and final answer. max steps, token budget, timeout. citations validated against actual chunk IDs/page metadata.
days.drill: a question requiring retrieval + SQL + calculation.
days.done: the trace shows multiple tools and the final structured answer cites verifiable evidence.

days.title: agent-platform: Week 1 integration + oral defense
days.build: integration tests for ingest -> retrieval -> agent answer. malformed tool output tests. model timeout simulation. SQL rejection tests. benchmark rerun from clean state. architecture diagram v1.
days.drill: Failure drill: kill Redis during a request and document what actually fails.
days.done: you can rebuild locally from README, demonstrate a cited multi-tool answer, and defend BM25/vector/hybrid/reranker choices with measured evidence.

days.title: agent-platform: Kafka and event contracts
days.build: Redpanda locally. typed events: RunRequested, StepStarted, StepFinished, ApprovalRequested, RunFinished, RunFailed. every event includes event_id, tenant_id, run_id, timestamp, schema version. producer/consumer smoke tests.

days.title: agent-platform: Durable worker, idempotency and DLQ
days.build: worker consumes run requests. idempotent (run_id, step_no) persistence. commit offsets only after durable state. exponential backoff + jitter. DLQ with retry/admin inspection. idempotency key on POST /runs.
days.drill: Failure drill: kill worker halfway through a multi-step run and restart it.
days.done: it resumes without duplicate side effects.

days.title: agent-platform: Async concurrency, streaming and backpressure
days.build: parallel independent tool nodes with bounded semaphore. per-tool timeout. SSE GET /runs/{id}/stream. cancellation endpoint. queue-depth metric.
days.drill: Load test: compare sequential vs bounded-parallel execution at multiple concurrent-user levels.

days.title: agent-platform: Human approval and resumable workflows
days.build: approval-required send_email or equivalent side-effect tool. ApprovalRequested state. POST /runs/{id}/approve and reject. expiry/timeouts. audit record.
days.drill: Failure drill: restart API + worker while a run waits for approval; it must still resume correctly.

days.title: agent-platform: OIDC, RBAC, RLS and Go gateway
days.build: Keycloak locally; Cognito-compatible architecture for cloud. roles: viewer/analyst/admin. JWT validation. endpoint RBAC. DB RLS activated per request. Go/chi gateway: JWT check, request ID, Redis token bucket, SSE passthrough. audit every mutation/tool call.
days.drill: Tests: role x endpoint matrix; tenant isolation; expired/bad token; rate limit.

days.title: agent-platform: MCP and agent topology comparison
days.build: expose internal tools through MCP. runtime becomes MCP client. add one safe third-party MCP server. implement same workflow three ways: direct single-agent, custom planner/executor, LangGraph.

days.title: agent-platform: Memory + Next.js vertical slice
days.build: short-term turn buffer in Redis. long-term facts in Postgres under RLS. summarization/compaction budget. forget/expiry semantics. memory isolation tests. Next.js demo: login, ask question, live steps, citations, approval button, usage view.
days.done: browser -> gateway -> API -> Kafka -> worker -> agents/tools -> cited result works; kill/restart behavior is demonstrated; cross-tenant tests pass; topology comparison has real numbers.

days.title: agent-platform: Evaluation dataset and regression harness
days.build: expand to >=75 evaluation questions tagged lookup/sql/multi-step/unanswerable/adversarial. expected evidence IDs for retrieval questions. retrieval metrics. answer correctness + faithfulness rubric. human-labeled subset >=20. compare LLM judge with human labels. abstention metric.
days.done: evaluation can be rerun with one command and produces a versioned report.

days.title: agent-platform: Security and threat model
days.build: SECURITY.md and threat model. poisoned-document injection suite. URL allowlist/private-IP blocking. PII redaction where appropriate. per-agent tool allowlists. secret scanning/dependency scanning. payload/input limits.
days.drill: Measure: attack success/block/abstain counts; document residual risks.

days.title: agent-platform: OpenTelemetry and SLOs
days.build: OTel gateway -> API -> Kafka -> worker -> LLM/tool spans. Prometheus/Grafana + Tempo or Phoenix. span attributes for model, tokens, cost, tenant, tool. dashboards: request rate, errors, P50/P95/P99, queue depth, LLM latency, retrieval latency, token/cost, DLQ. define explicit SLOs and alert thresholds.
days.done: one run is traceable end-to-end across the async boundary.

days.title: agent-platform: AWS + Terraform + CI/CD
days.build: Terraform modules for network, compute, DB/cache/broker choices, IAM, secrets, observability as practical. container registry. staging deployment. GitHub Actions: lint/test/security/build/deploy. migrations in deployment path. rollback procedure.

days.title: agent-platform: Load test and performance engineering
days.build: k6/Locust load tests. scenarios: read-heavy retrieval, multi-tool run creation, streaming concurrent runs. find first bottleneck rather than guessing. make one optimization and rerun identical test.
days.drill: Measure before/after: throughput, P50/P95/P99, error rate, CPU/memory, DB pool, queue depth, token cost.
days.done: BENCHMARKS.md contains a defensible before/after optimization result.
